facts: Humanity hides behind enormous concentric walls while giant humanoid enemies roam outside.
Military trainees use grappling gear and blades to fight threats much larger than themselves.
Its mysteries mix royal bloodlines, basement secrets, and a war far beyond the first walled city.
A kind teenager enters a school for curse-fighters after swallowing a dangerous object.
Sorcerers use personal techniques to battle monsters born from negative emotion.
Blindfolds, domain battles, and a demonic presence inside the hero are major clues.
A student gains a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written inside.
A genius detective, a shinigami, and potato-chip theatrics are major clues.
The story becomes a cat-and-mouse battle over justice, ego, and surveillance.
Most people have superhuman abilities, but the main student begins without one.
A prestigious training school prepares teenagers through exams, rescues, and villain attacks.
Inherited power, costume design, and professional rankings are major clues.
A bored hero defeats almost every enemy with a single casual hit.
The joke comes from overwhelming strength creating an existential crisis instead of glory.
Monster rankings, hero associations, and deadpan training routines are major clues.
A shy student becomes half-monster after a violent encounter and an organ transplant.
Coffee shops, masks, and hunger for human flesh are central clues.
The story explores identity between human society and a hidden predator world.
A rubber-bodied pirate gathers a crew to chase the world's greatest treasure.
Devil fruits, wanted posters, sea routes, and found-family crews are major clues.
Its long voyage moves through strange islands, corrupt governments, and dreams of freedom.
An ostracized young ninja wants recognition from his village and carries a sealed beast inside.
Headbands, hand signs, rival clans, and exams for young warriors are major clues.
The story builds around friendship, revenge, inherited trauma, and becoming village leader.
Players are trapped inside a virtual fantasy game where dying in-game means dying outside too.
Floating castles, blade skills, and romance inside digital worlds are major clues.
The first arc turns a multiplayer fantasy adventure into a survival prison.
